title: Release procedure: version, changelog, tag
acceptance: Release steps in docs/agents/areas.md ("Consumers and releases"): bump, changelog, PR, tag vX.Y.Z on main
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
